learned_model.name: ISOLATION FOREST
learned_model.note: Fitted on 240 steady-state healthy residual vectors pooled across four cylinders.
learned_model.abstention: Reports UNTRAINED and contributes zero to the fused score until it has enough healthy evidence.

baseline_model.name: PHYSICS RESIDUAL GLM
baseline_model.note: Built first on purpose. A learned model that cannot beat an interpretable baseline is a finding, not a failure.

fusion.rule: An untrained or unavailable learned model contributes zero. Disagreement between the two detectors is published, not averaged away.

fault_classification.detail: NGAFID-MC labels 2,111 unplanned maintenance events across 36 issue types at the FLIGHT level. There is no per-cylinder, per-second fault label anywhere in the corpus, so a supervised per-cylinder classifier would have to invent its own targets. Diagnosis therefore runs on unsupervised residual anomaly detection plus a named physical mechanism, and the mechanism is always reported as LIKELY CONTRIBUTING, never as confirmed.
fault_classification.what_would_change_it: A labelled test-rig campaign - induced valve distress, plug fouling, cooling-baffle damage - through the same adapter.
